hypotheses.scoring: Relative FAIL/PASS density adds predictive information at fixed coordinates; additional capacity may explain part of the gain.
hypotheses.representation: Reference-only PCA fitting and feature standardization may affect disjoint generalization independently of scoring.
hypotheses.selection: Template-grouped final-reference CV may select dimensions with better disjoint performance than random KFold.
hypotheses.interaction: Scoring gains may depend on representation and dimension selection; improvements need not be additive.

population: Llama13/Gemma12, fair layers16/21, standard/disjoint, reference100, seeds0-4, unchanged strict samples5-9 labels
outer_control: Freeze exact original ordered references and tests, including10 synthetic references; no new inference.
dependency: Earlier CV affects balanced acquisition. Freeze original acquisition history. Intervene only on final-reference selection using exact original final-step candidate dimensions, pre-update component count and regularization. This is not an end-to-end grouped acquisition experiment.
selection_objective: Original PASS-density normalized rank vs continuous reference pass-rate correlation, original asymmetric dimension selection rule; identical selected dimension for all scoring methods. No classifier-specific tuning.
group_rules: GT strings for reference rows only; synthetic templates unique. GroupKFold min(3,n_groups). Require every fold >=original k passing training rows, both validation classes, >=2 validation rows. Otherwise grouped cell ineligible; no random fallback.
PCA: Original captured candidate coordinates unchanged. New PCA fits per dimension once, sklearn PCA default with explicit random_state=seed. Reference_raw does not standardize. Reference_standardized uses StandardScaler reference only. Reference transforms may see inner-validation covariates but never outer-test covariates or labels; this dependence is documented.
density: Original final component count/reg_covar frozen across primary cells; full covariance, n_init30, max_iter500,tol1e-3,seed. CV n_init10. LR reference-coordinate StandardScaler,C1,balanced,max_iter3000.
capacity_controls: At original coordinates/selection: PASS-only2k components (approximately same density parameter budget as two k-component densities), relative pooled/PASS with k-component pooled reference background, and reg_covar sensitivity0.01/1.0 for both PASS and relative density. Controls explicitly change fitting population or flexibility, not perfect identification.
fit_estimate: 250 jobs;27 primary cells/job. Reuse fits per representation/dimension; <=250*(original replay~300 mixture fits +3 representations*3 candidates*3 folds*10-start fits+3*4 dims*2 final30-start fits+controls) ~110000 estimator fits counting multistart as one estimator. Approximately1-3 CPU hours with4 processes; benchmark before expansion. No GPU.
secondary: Reference200 only if primary full validation/reporting fits session budget; repeat all primary cells, never choose by outer performance. Otherwise explicitly omit.
reliable_labels: Reuse stored p40 per-input rates if present, else restore existing40-generation files. Never change training/CV labels. Evaluate original5,40-majority, stable40(p40<=0.1 or>=0.9 and agrees with5). Explicitly report coverage and common systems.
statistics: AUROC,FAIL-positive average precision,prevalence; per-job then per-seed system macro mean and sample SD. Paired system-cluster bootstrap4000,seed20261112,retaining5 seeds. Common systems must have all5 seeds for each paired contrast. Difference-in-differences for interactions; split gap on identical test-index intersections as well as full tests.
validation: Original AUROC vs captured/stored baseline tolerance1e-12; final CV choice exactly original; reference/test order and labels identical; zero grouped overlap; all scores finite; report convergence/failures; deterministic isolated rerun; old artifact hashes unchanged. Do not relax AUROC tolerances.
pre_expansion_numerical_diagnosis: HDFS pilot before factorial outcomes: Python3.10 and3.12 on this Haswell VM both reproduce AUROC but float32 PCA coordinates drift1.204e-5 and scores0.00399 relative to historical artifacts. Refit on archived exact coordinates reduces score drift to1.03e-11; using archived density parameters gives4.55e-13. Therefore use archived exact final-selected coordinates and archived PASS/relative/LR score vectors as original controls (completed experiments reused). Other candidate coordinates are current seeded reconstructions. Record all numerical deviations; do not claim bit-identical cross-hardware replay. Numerical score mismatch is diagnosed, not presented as new baseline evidence.
recovery_gate_application: During recovery the same drift perturbed a few balanced acquisition ties, so explicitly follow archived ordered reference prefixes (the prespecified frozen-acquisition intervention). If the original final dimension trajectory cannot be recovered, exclude all reselected random/grouped cells for that job; retain archived original representation/scoring and frozen16 interventions. Never force selected dimensions to make a CV intervention pass. Original AUROC validation stays1e-12 against archived controls and canonical job values, never a relaxed score/AUC tolerance. Fresh replay AUROC mismatches are recorded as failures of cross-hardware replay, not misrepresented as exact. Eligibility decisions are numerical-recovery gates, not chosen by ablation gains.
